rationale: The filing contains a single final schedule grand-total row: Total Portfolio Investments at fair value of $2,153,908 thousand. It equals the balance-sheet Total investments, at fair value line and the companyfacts value. The separately shown non-controlled/non-affiliated and non-controlled/affiliated debt and equity sections roll into this row; there is no separate controlled-investments schedule to add. Cash and cash equivalents and short-term investments are presented in a following row and are not part of investments at fair value.
